name: Motorcycle Simulator Spain
summary:
Ride Madrid from the seat - alone or with your friends.

38 KM ROUND MADRID
North on the M-30 past the Las Ventas bullring and Torrespana, west on Calle 30 with the Cuatro Torres skyline right beside you, up the M-607 past Fuencarral, then the M-40 round the north-east of the city past the Metropolitano stadium, and home on the A-3.

RIDE IT LIKE A REAL BIKE
